summary: This 6-K filing by Studio City International Holdings Ltd reports that its subsidiary, Studio City Finance Limited, issued a notice of partial redemption for $165 million of its $500 million 6.500% Senior Notes due 2028. The redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued interest to July 18, 2026. This is a routine debt management action, not a special situation. The filing does not involve a change of control, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or any other special-situations category. It is a standard liability management transaction by a foreign issuer reporting under Rule 13a-16.
